# 🎯 feat: Core Utilities & Configuration Engine (`v0.2.0`)

{{DYNAMIC_METADATA}}

## 📌 Summary
This PR introduces Log4j2 logging, a configuration manager, screenshot utility, and an enhanced browser factory. All `System.out.println` calls are replaced with proper logging. The framework now supports external configuration via `config.properties`.

## 📂 Files Introduced or Modified
```txt
📦 playwright-hybrid-framework/
├── 📄 pom.xml                     # Added Log4j2 dependencies
├── 📁 src/main/java/
│   ├── 📄 BrowserFactory.java     # Centralised browser creation (🆕)
│   ├── 📄 ConfigReader.java       # Loads config.properties (🆕)
│   └── 📄 ScreenshotUtil.java     # Captures screenshots (🆕)
├── 📁 src/test/java/
│   ├── 📁 tests/
│   │   └── 📄 TC_001.java         # Refactored to use logging
│   └── 📁 utils/
│       └── 📄 Log4j2Config.java   # (optional) Log initialiser
├── 📁 src/test/resources/
│   ├── 📄 log4j2.xml              # Log4j2 configuration (🆕)
│   └── 📄 config.properties       # Runtime configuration (🆕)
└── 📁 logs/                       # Log files directory (auto-created)
```

## 🎯 Key Features Introduced
- [x] **Log4j2 (v2.26.0)** – console + file logging
- [x] **ConfigReader** – reads properties from `config.properties`
- [x] **BrowserFactory** – supports headless/headed, browser type, slowMo, etc.
- [x] **ScreenshotUtil** – saves PNG screenshots on demand or test failure
- [x] **Refactored TC_001** – all print statements replaced with `log.info`
- [x] **CI integration** – uploads logs and screenshots as artifacts

##🛠️ How to Verify
1. Run test locally:

```bash
mvn clean test
```
2. Check `console logs` – `coloured`, `timestamped`, `levels` (`INFO`, `DEBUG`, `ERROR`).
3. Verify log file created at `./logs/automation.log`.
4. Change `browser=firefox` in `src/test/resources/config.properties` and run test – should launch Firefox.
5. Force a failure (e.g., wrong selector) – screenshot saved in `./screenshots/`.

## 📝 Configuration Example (config.properties)
```properties
browser=chromium
headless=true
slowMo=100
base.url=https://demoqa.com
screenshot.on.failure=true
```
